headline: 逃亡者领跑影市 狂热先生掀追剧潮
summary: 今日影市由《逃亡者》领跑，《坠落2：死点》同样吸睛；电视端新剧《狂热先生》首播亮眼，《龙族》《瑞克和莫蒂》持续热播。

industryHighlights.text: 《逃亡者》成为本周最热电影，票房口碑双丰收。
industryHighlights.en: The Fugitive is the week's hottest movie, earning both box office and praise.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧《狂热先生》本周首播，话题度迅速攀升。
industryHighlights.en: New series Mr. Frenzy premiered this week and quickly gained buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续热播，保持高讨论度。
industryHighlights.en: House of the Dragon continues its hot run with strong buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《生化危机：爆发夜》等新片蓄势待映。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films including Resident Evil: Outbreak Night are highly anticipated.

headlineEn: The Fugitive Leads Box Office, Mr. Frenzy Sparks Binge Wave
summaryEn: The Fugitive tops today's box office while Fall 2: Dead Point also shines; on TV, new series Mr. Frenzy debuts strongly, with Dragon House and Rick and Morty still dominating.
